purpose: Plan future audio pipeline options without changing live runtime behavior.

source_grounding.relevance: Liquid Audio repo describes interleaved generation for real-time speech-to-speech and sequential generation for ASR/TTS.
Model card describes LFM2.5-Audio as end-to-end audio foundation model with interleaved and sequential generation, ASR, TTS, English support, and LFM Open License.
Liquid docs describe audio models as audio/text-in and audio/text-out models supporting TTS, speech recognition, and audio-to-audio.

strengths: Each boundary is inspectable and testable.
Transcript text is available before verifier and memory updates.
Provider TTS can stay replaceable behind a controlled adapter.
Sales brain remains project-owned and source-grounded.
risks: Higher end-to-end latency from separate components.
ASR errors can propagate into sales state unless quality gates catch them.
Prosody and text generation are loosely coupled.
pipelines.live_use_status: existing architecture reference only; no Phase 4I0 behavior change

strengths: Interleaved audio/text generation could reduce time-to-first-audio if local hardware supports it.
A single audio model may support ASR, TTS, and speech-to-speech experiments.
Candidate transcript can feed project-owned verifier and memory ledger if extraction is reliable.
risks: Generated audio may contain unsupported product claims unless gated before playback.
Partial streaming audio may become unsafe if verifier only sees final text.
Speech-to-speech model could accidentally become the sales brain if boundaries are not enforced.
Local VRAM and latency on RTX 4070 Super 12GB are unknown.
hard_constraints: Liquid must not become the unverified sales/conversation brain.
Campaign facts, source grounding, memory ledger, and safety verifier remain project-owned.
No generated audio can be played live before verifier gating is specified and benchmarked.
No live wiring until ASR, TTS, transcript extraction, latency, and hallucination gates pass.
pipelines.live_use_status: blocked until later feasibility and benchmark phases

feasibility_questions: Can Liquid run locally on RTX 4070 Super 12GB?
Can it do ASR on known bad phrases?
Can it produce TTS fast enough?
Can we extract transcript text for verifier/memory?
Can we prevent hallucinated product facts?
Can generated audio be gated by verifier before playback?
Is streaming partial audio safe in a sales conversation?
What must be blocked from live use until verified?
blocked_from_live_use_until_verified: partial audio streaming before verifier gate
Liquid-derived product facts or sales claims
memory updates from unverified transcript extraction
provider or local model calls in live demo paths
replacement of current ElevenLabs provider path
recommended_next_phase: Run Liquid feasibility probe only after explicit approval for installs/downloads; keep all outputs evidence-only and no live wiring.
